rules.description: Esc -> Esc + switch to ABC input source
Backtick -> switch to ABC, then emit Backtick after 50 ms
Kitty Cmd+Opt+V / Cmd+Shift+V: paste image to safe2
Right Command -> Control-Space input source switch

manipulators.description: Caps + Control + , -> Focus Left Display / 聚焦左侧显示器
Caps + Control + . -> Focus Right Display / 聚焦右侧显示器
Caps + Shift + D => Show Desktop via Cmd+Ctrl+Opt+Shift+D
Caps + M => Delete To Line Start
Caps + Space -> Esc + switch to ABC input source
Caps + Q -> Esc + switch to ABC input source
Caps + Control + \ -> Last Window / 返回上一个窗口
Caps + Control + ] -> Next Window / 下一个窗口
Caps + Control + [ -> Previous Window / 上一个窗口
